mapper.sql: id, name, address, longitude, latitude, cover_image AS coverImage, phone, layout_image AS layoutImage, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM biz_store
AND status = #{status}
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_store(name, address, longitude, latitude, cover_image, phone, layout_image, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{coverImage}, #{phone}, #{layoutImage}, #{status})
